Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity for EHR NLP pipeline — initial ask

Hi Samira — great to reconnect. Attached are a concise workbook and a draft proposal (pdf) with three tailored reservation tracks. TL;DR below, with key assumptions and immediate next steps.

Assumptions (from our call):
- Mixed workload: interactive low-latency chat + nightly batch rerank.
- Peak model profile: 12k token-streaming tokens/minute for interactive paths; nightly batch jobs equivalent to ~2x peak for short windows.
- Target utilization: aim for 65–75% sustained to leave headroom for bursts.

Option A — Onramp (low-friction)
- Cluster: 24 x A10G or equivalent (single SKU for simplicity)
- Minimum floor: 8 GPUs reserved for 3 months (soft floor: billed but can be reallocated during agreed maintenance windows)
- Ramp: month 1 = 8 (floor), month 2 = 12, month 3 = 18, month 4+ = 24
- Prewarm credits: 40 hours per GPU allocated during month 1 for KV cache prebuild / model warm-up
- Typical activation lead time: 7–10 business days from signed LOI
- Ballpark committed price band: see workbook (range shown per GPU-month)

Option B — Growth (recommended median)
- Cluster: 48 x A100s (preferred for lower latency & batch throughput)
- Minimum floor: 24 GPUs reserved (hard floor for SLA)
- Ramp: month 1 = 24, month 2 = 32, month 3 = 40, month 4 = 48
- Prewarm credits: 60 hours/GPU month 1 + 20 hours/GPU month 2
- Activation lead time: 10–14 business days; can parallelize procurement + networking to shorten
- Add-on: burst pool (up to +20% capacity) for short windows at metered overage rates

Option C — Anchor (scale + economics)
- Cluster: 96 x mixed H100 + A100 pool (H100s for high-throughput training-adjacent jobs)
- Minimum floor: 48 GPUs reserved (split 60/40 H100/A100)
- Ramp: staged over 12 months with quarterly checkpoints and optional step-up windows
- Prewarm credits: negotiated; typically includes sustained KV cache warmers and dedicated on-call for initial 30 days
- Activation lead time: 4–6 weeks (network/KMS and compliance checks can extend)

Operational controls and guardrails:
- Autoscaling policy templates (we suggest target utilization ceilings and burst windows).
- Prefix/KV caching strategy (we'll suggest initial cache sizes in the workbook based on your sample traces).
- Rollout plan: canary at 5–10% traffic, 24–72 hour evaluation windows, automatic fallback to hosted variants if errors exceed threshold.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which option to put into LOI draft (we can put a Growth anchor with an 8-week activation SLA).
2) Ben and I will align on final pricing bands and a short SOW; I'll also include SOC2 artifacts and our audit contact.
3) If fine, I'll share a DocuSign LOI and we can kick network onboarding in parallel.

I've cc'd Ben to simplify pricing/commit clarifications. Happy to jump on a 30m call today if helpful.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Olga. Quick notes from infra/pricing lens:

1) Floor suggestions: adjust to be slightly higher to avoid frequent autoscale churn given nightly batch spikes — propose: Starter floor = 12 (not 8), Growth floor = 32 (not 24), Anchor floor = 56 (not 48). We can offer a stepped billing credit for the first 2 months to smooth their spend while they ramp.

2) Ramp cadence: keep 4–6 week step-ups rather than monthly jumps for Growth; gives us time to validate KV cache effectiveness and reduces cold-cache tail latency.

3) GPU mix: recommend offering a blended A100/H100 option for Growth where 30% of slot hours are H100 for batch windows (saves them time on nightly reranks). Price the H100 hours separately in workbook.

4) Prewarm credits: 60h/GPU month1 is ok but tie any credits beyond month1 to measurable cache hit-rate improvements, e.g., we can release credits if 75%+ cache hit is not reached.

5) SLA / activation: 10–14 business days is realistic if they sign LOI and share networking/KMS details within 5 business days. Otherwise add a clause that lead times may extend.

I'll whip a short pricing appendix and a suggested billing smoothing clause for LOI.

Karthik
Chief Architect — Serving Runtime
